annotations.text:
LIVE VIEW — a control instrument.
One dominant thing: the physical action, sized to read from two metres while your hand is on the knob. The number that caused it sits below; peak and clipping are deliberately small because they are guards, not targets.

SESSION REPORT — a record, not an instrument.
Leads with a verdict, then the time series. Compare the two chart shapes: steady vs sliding is legible before you read a single number.

The state that matters most.
Grey, never green — and it says WHY. "Your level is fine" and "nothing has been said yet" are different facts.
